item.title: Jalen Duren’s surge for East-leading Pistons tests Magic
item.description: One word springs to mind for Detroit forward Ausar Thompson when asked to describe teammate Jalen Duren’s recent surge.

item.title: Why Travis Kelce’s decision is much more complex than last year for the Chiefs
item.description: KANSAS CITY, Mo. — The focus of the NFL scouting combine is the looming draft and the flood of college prospects who will comprise it. It’s a head start on a free-agency window that opens in a couple of weeks. It’s the chance to finalize an ideal blueprint for the next couple of months.

item.title: Mark Sanchez accused of being on multiple drugs during stabbing incident
item.description: Former Jets quarterback Mark Sanchez may have been under the influence of several illicit drugs during his violent encounter with a truck driver in Indianapolis last year, at least according to court documents filed by the alleged victim.

item.title: Nikola Jokic reacts to Lu Dort trip after altercation: ‘Unnecessary move. And a necessary reaction.’
item.description: OKLAHOMA CITY — A man of few words, Nikola Jokic was candid and concise with his thoughts on the Luguentz Dort flagrant foul that provoked him to get in Dort’s face Friday night.

item.title: Arkansas RB Mike Washington Jr. cries tears of joy after 40-yard dash at NFL combine
item.description: After posting a 4.33-second 40-yard dash at the NFL combine on Saturday, broadcast cameras captured former Arkansas running back Mike Washington Jr. shedding what appeared to be tears of joy.

item.title: Keaau health center might be ready by 2028; cost of new facility could reach $90M
item.description: The estimated cost for a new outpatient medical facility to be built in Keaau by Hilo Benioff Medical Center has increased from $60 million to as much as $90 million.

item.title: HIDOT advances $7 billion overhaul of airports
item.description: The state Department of Transportation is advancing a $7 billion pipeline of airport construction and modernization projects over the next six to seven years, a scale Hawaii has never attempted before as it works to overhaul terminals, airfields and support facilities statewide.

item.title: QAnon faithful see validation in the Epstein files
item.description: The theory at the heart of the QAnon conspiracy theory was simple, even if the details were not: A global cabal of elites was running a child sex-trafficking ring.

item.title: US, Israel attack Iran
item.description: Iran’s Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei was killed on Saturday, state media confirmed, after the United States and Israel launched the most ambitious attack on Iranian targets in decades.
